messages:
Nina: Quick sync  we wrapped the interview with AurumHealth. Need the following before publish: signed release, one short homepage quote, two social blurbs, and a webinar speaker. Target launch: Mon AM. Recording + notes: https://drive.google.com/aurum-interview :sparkles:

Carlos: Great. They mentioned cutting inference spend ~45% and that tail latency improved. They asked that we do not name their previous vendor.

Tara (CS): Confirmed. Tech angle: batching + prefix cache gave most of the wins. I can draft a 1-line technical pull.

Rafi (Legal): Please send the standard customer release. If we're using an approximate metric ("~45%" or "about 2x cost reduction") that's fine. If you want a precise comparison or vendor name, we need supporting docs and explicit written confirmation. I uploaded the release template: https://drive.google.com/open?id=aurum-release-template

Nina: Carlos  please draft two quote options (cost-first and dev-speed) and paste into the doc. Also confirm if Aurum will present at a webinar.

Carlos: Added two options to the doc: 
> "Redwood lowered our inference spend by about 45% while improving tail latency."
> "Using Redwood, we shipped a new chat feature in under three weeks."

Tara (CS): I'll be the webinar speaker if they want a short demo + Q&A. Recommend 30 min + 15 Q&A.

OpsBot: Transcript processed and stored at /files/3612345678-aurum-transcript.txt

Nina: @Aurum contact (cc'd via DM)  can you confirm which quote you'd like and sign the release? Also, would you join the webinar as a customer speaker?

(Aurum Marketing): Replies via DM: "Happy to sign. Please use the first quote with 'about 45%'. We won't name the prior vendor. We can join the webinar for a 10min customer segment." Attached signed release: https://drive.google.com/file/d/aurum-signed-release.pdf

Rafi (Legal): Reviewed the signed release. Approved language: "Redwood lowered our inference spend by about 45% while improving tail latency." Cleared for blog, social, and webinar promo.

Carlos: Perfect. Final pull quote locked. I'll create the quote graphic and two tweet-length lines and upload.

Carlos: Uploaded assets: /marketing/assets/aurum-quote-card.png, /marketing/assets/aurum-social-1.png. Pasted social lines in doc: 
- "AurumHealth cut inference spend ~45% with Redwood  better tail latency, simplified ops."
- "Launched new conversational triage in weeks after moving to Redwood."

Nina: I'll set HubSpot routing: tag=case-study/aurumhealth, owner=NA SDR queue. @OpsBot please attach the signed release and transcript to any inbound from the campaign.

OpsBot: HubSpot rule created. Tag=case-study/aurumhealth, owner=NA_SDRs. Release + transcript will be attached automatically.

Tara (CS): I'll prepare slides and a short demo repo. Draft slides uploaded: /marketing/assets/aurum-webinar-slides-v1.pdf. Webinar tentatively Tue 11am, customer will join for the 10min segment.

Nina: Scheduling calendar event and internal sales preview for Mon 9am. I'll also prepare the launch post (short blog excerpt + social copy).

Rafi (Legal): One last note: keep the quote verbatim as in the signed release. Any edits need re-approval.

Carlos: Noted. Using exact approved wording.

Nina: Thanks team  final checklist: signed release in Drive, transcript + trimmed audio, assets uploaded, HubSpot routing set, webinar slides in folder. Closing thread once blog + RSVP page are live.
